_comment: The pinned versions of the comma parts (docs/comma-pack-format.md). 'starpilot': the public StarPilot source Mapd's generator is built from (mapd.py setup). 'go': the Go toolchain Mapd's go.mod asks for; mapd.py setup downloads go.dev's archive for the machine (go<version>.<platform>.tar.gz) and installs it only when its size and SHA-256 are the ones pinned here per platform; a platform without a pin is refused (bytes and sha256 as go.dev's download list, https://go.dev/dl/?mode=json&include=all, gives them, read once on 2026-11-22; the list is not read at setup). 'engines': the pyvalhalla wheels comma.json offers (catalog.py): bytes, sha256 and blake2b_256 as PyPI's JSON (https://pypi.org/pypi/pyvalhalla/3.9.1/json) gives them, read on 2026-11-22. PyPI's url of a file is files.pythonhosted.org/packages/<b[:2]>/<b[2:4]>/<b[4:]>/<file>, b its blake2b_256, and catalog.py writes it that way: the url itself is not written here because the packs repository's privacy scan refuses a 60-digit hex run. 'search_code': the frozen release of the search code a comma runs (docs/comma-pack-format.md 2, part search_code): query.py, lines.py and normalize.py of the folder named here, with LF line ends as git stores them; search_code.py builds search-code.tar from that folder only and refuses a file whose size or SHA-256 is not the one pinned here, and every check of the part (search_code.py --verify, check.py, catalog.py) refuses a tar whose three .py members are not these. Release 1 is the code of the first published pack with comma files (release us-pa-202611220901; packbuilder/search as of commit d8336cc); StarPilot's source pins the same SHA-256. A new release is a deliberate act: copy the three files from packbuilder/search into the folder, write their bytes and SHA-256 here with the next release number, and have StarPilot's pin list take the new SHA-256 before a pack carries them.
